thread:
Priya Sharma: Heads upnoticed the Help panel on the Dashboard uses 'projects' while onboarding docs use 'workspaces' which is confusing for new users. Screenshot attached: https://redwood.app/s/ux-snap-19
Connor (UX): oof. we had a naming debate last quarter and docs defaulted to 'workspaces' but the Console team didn't land on that.
Ben (Docs): canonical term in the handbook is 'workspace'. we should probably migrate UI to match docs. leaving both in the product is risky.
Jules (Frontend): switching label is a small change but saved routes, permalinks, and test fixtures will need updates. also confirm copy casing.
Maya (A11y): please ensure aria labels and announcement text in the sidebar remain stable after the rename so screen reader users aren't thrown off.
Priya Sharma: propose: change Dashboard header to 'Workspace Dashboard' and help panel title to 'Workspace docs'. add a short inline note: "Previously called 'projects' in older UI."
Connor (UX): agree. also suggest adding a tooltip on hover for 2 weeks post-ship that says 'We're renaming projects to workspaces' to help discoverability. small modal? maybe tooltip is less disruptive.
Ben (Docs): i'll update docs and add cross-link to the in-product panel: /docs/workspaces?utm=console-help
Jules (Frontend): i'll coordinate with QA to sweep saved links and update tests. i'll also ensure the help panel flyout uses aria-live politely when title changes.
notify-bot: test notification: scheduled a brief rollout window Fri 02:00 UTC
Maya (A11y): after rollout i'll run NVDA/VoiceOver quick pass. will flag if anything regresses.
Priya Sharma: timeline: target next week. i'll write the tiny RFC and tag #console and #docs. thanks y'all :sparkles:
